item.title: How did boosting manufacturing in the Amazon pay off for Brazil?
item.description: Many countries talk about wanting to boost manufacturing. Decades ago, Brazil did it. They lured international businesses to build a whole bunch of factories in the middle of the Amazon. So, with hindsight, was the plan a success? Planet Money goes to the Amazon to find out.

item.title: The U.S. economy is still growing, but at a slower pace
item.description: The U.S. economy continues to grow, but at a slower pace than earlier in the year. GDP grew at an annual pace of 1.5% during April, May and June.
